blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) has intensified anti-drug operations across Metro Manila following the killing of two alleged drug personalities inside a suspected drug den in Tondo, Manila. The two victims were shot dead by unidentified gunmen inside a house in Barangay 194 early Friday. Barangay officials said the house was allegedly being used as a drug den. The Manila Police District is conducting a follow-up investigation to identify and arrest the gunmen. “We cannot allow illegal drugs to continue destroying our communities,” NCRPO officer-in-charge Brig.
